blocks.text: At 66, Rosalinda Caparanga wanted more than a way to fill her days. She wanted responsibilities of her own, the independence of earning an income, and the satisfaction of contributing through her work. She found that opportunity at Chowking, where she helps clear tables and keep the dining area in order. For Caparanga, the work offers a reason to stay active and a sense of belonging to a team. At another Jollibee Group brand, Greenwich, 70-year-old retired overseas Filipino worker Manuel Moran has found his own opportunity to contribute by taking on a job unlike any he had done before.
